mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.entity_provider_mounts (game_id, entity_id, provider_id, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{entityId}, #{providerId}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, provider_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", entity_id AS "entityId", provider_id AS "providerId", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.entity_provider_mounts WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, entity_id, provider_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.entity_provider_mounts_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, entity_id, provider_id ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, entity_id, provider_id FROM public.entity_provider_mounts WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, entity_id, provider_id, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision
